The third sentence of Section 2 of Executive Order No. 45 dated January.
05,1993 is hereby amended to read as follows:
:::::..
"SEC. 2. x x x There shall be a transition period up to year 2005 to allow::::...
integration of the old surveys, after which only PRS Q2 shall be recognized as the.:::
standard reference system for all surveys and maps in the country."
.: ...
